text:
When I count the seeds

sown down there

to flower so, side by side;


when I examine the people

who lie so low

to rise so high;


when I think that the garden

mortals will not see

has chance reap its buds

and draw lots for this bee,

I can do without summer, without complaint.

translation.title: When I Count the Seeds...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the seed/grave/garden logic of Dickinson as mediated through the Spanish text.
